title: Beachfront Existing Resort-Coron
description: Set along a peaceful and secluded stretch of Busuanga in Coron, Palawan, this stunning 1.6-hectare titled beachfront property offers approximately 180 meters of private shoreline framed by crystal-clear waters and untouched nature.

The estate is already home to a fully operating resort, complete with twelve duplex cottage rooms, traditional nipa huts, a swimming pool, a beachfront bar, and restaurant facilities. With both solar and commercial power options, easy road access, and utilities available nearby, the groundwork is in place for an immediate income-generating operation.

For the visionary investor, the potential is extraordinary. The property is ideally suited for expansion into a luxury resort, wellness retreat, boutique hotel, or exclusive beachfront development — a rare opportunity in one of the Philippines' most sought-after tourism destinations. This is a unique chance to own privacy, natural beauty, and unlimited room to grow in the heart of Palawan's tourism paradise.
accessNotes: From Coron town proper: approximately 50–60 minutes by van or car (around 50–55 km depending on route and road conditions).
From Francisco B. Reyes Airport (Busuanga Airport): approximately 25–30 minutes by van or car (around 21.5 km away).
